name: Telecom Services 4
definition: Telecom services carries telephony billing data.

CustomerAccountNumber.name: Customer Account Number
CustomerAccountNumber.definition: Customer account number with the service provider.

BillingStart.name: Billing Start
BillingStart.definition: Contains the billing period start date for telecommunication or related services.

BillingEnd.name: Billing End
BillingEnd.definition: Contains the billing period end date for telecommunication or related services.

BillingEvent.name: Billing Event
BillingEvent.definition: Summary of the charges associated with the billing event.

TotalTax.name: Total Tax
TotalTax.definition: Total of taxes applicable to the billing amount.

TotalAmount.name: Total Amount
TotalAmount.definition: Total amount includes amounts of all the billing events and total tax amounts.

LineItem.name: Line Item
LineItem.definition: Telecom Services Line Item component is designed to carry detail level telephony billing data and to enable issuers to supply more transaction information to their consumer and corporate clients pertaining to telecommunications services and related billing information.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
